narr: Heavy rain from a good monsoonal push, caused flash flooding in eastern Nevada.
ev: Spotter reported via Facebook, that water running over US Highway 50, about 2 miles SE of Ruth. The observer sent a photo and estimated the water was about 6 to 12 inches over the road. Some sand and silt were noted in the photo as well.
lsr: SPOTTER VIA FACEBOOK REPORTED WATER RUNNING OVER US HIGHWAY 50, ABOUT 2 MILES SOUTHEAST OF RUTH. DEPTH OF WATER WAS ESTIMATED TO BE 6 TO 12 INCHES DEEP. SOME SAND AND SILT WAS NOTED IN THE PHOTO.
